content.user_title: Improve Dutch Copy with Natural Rewriting
content.value_statement: Dutch business copy can sound stiff when it repeats formal transitions and passive constructions. This guide helps an AI agent identify those patterns and suggest natural Dutch or Belgian Dutch rewrites.
actual_capabilities: Guide an agent to identify formal transitions, passive constructions, and repetitive three-part structures in Dutch text.
Request a 0-5 style rating with explanations of the linguistic signals behind it.
Suggest shorter sentences and active phrasing while aiming to preserve the original intent.
Guide rewrites toward standard Dutch or conversational Belgian Dutch.
Review Dutch business and web copy for repetitive wording and generic filler.
limitations: The package contains only a Markdown guide; scripts, extension source, templates, and an executable scoring engine are not included.
The guide does not define a complete scoring formula or provide validated AI authorship detection.
Linguistic review does not verify factual accuracy; rewritten claims require human review.
Creative literature may receive misleading style flags, and output quality depends on the host agent.

use_cases.title: Edit Dutch campaign copy
use_cases.description: Identify filler and repetitive sentence patterns, then request a clearer version that preserves the campaign message.

use_cases.title: Adapt copy for Belgian readers
use_cases.description: Convert formal Netherlands Dutch into conversational Belgian Dutch while retaining product names and factual claims.

use_cases.title: Review website language
use_cases.description: Ask an agent to flag passive voice and formal transitions in service descriptions before editorial approval.

prompt_templates.title: Identify style signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Dutch text for formal filler and repetitive patterns: [text]. Give a 0-5 style rating and list supporting phrases.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a short paragraph.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite in standard Dutch
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this text in natural standard Dutch: [text]. Shorten sentences and use active voice. Preserve facts and show the main changes.

prompt_templates.title: Localize for Belgian readers
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this copy into conversational Belgian Dutch for [audience]: [text]. Preserve product names, prices, and claims. Explain the main register changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate localization for a defined audience.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and compare multiple passages
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these Dutch passages: [passages]. Rate each from 0-5 with cited signals. Rewrite for [audience] in [register]. Preserve facts and flag uncertain edits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced editorial review across several passages.

output_examples.input: Review and simplify: Uiteraard is het belangrijk om te vermelden dat onze software tevens tijd bespaart.
output: Signals: Uiteraard, het is belangrijk om te vermelden, and tevens add formal filler.

output_examples.input: Rewrite in conversational Belgian Dutch: Uw aanvraag wordt door ons team binnen twee werkdagen behandeld.
output: Signal: The passive construction makes the sentence less direct.
Rewrite: Ons team behandelt je aanvraag binnen twee werkdagen.
The rewrite keeps the two-business-day timeframe and uses an informal register.

best_practices: Specify the intended audience, Dutch variant, and formality level before requesting a rewrite.
Ask for cited phrases behind each style rating and treat the number as an editorial estimate.
Compare the rewrite with the original to verify facts, promises, and terminology before publication.
anti_patterns: Treating a style rating as proof that a person or AI wrote the text.
Removing every formal expression without considering audience, genre, or required terminology.
Publishing rewrites without checking for changed claims or unsupported additions.

faq.question: What does this skill include?
faq.answer: It includes a Markdown guide for Dutch style review and rewriting. The public folder excludes scripts, extension source, and original-package templates.

faq.question: Can it prove that text was generated by AI?
faq.answer: No. It flags writing patterns, not authorship. Human writing can contain the same patterns.

faq.question: How reliable is the 0-5 rating?
faq.answer: The guide describes a linguistic rating but supplies no complete scoring formula or validation data. Treat ratings as agent-generated editorial estimates.

faq.question: Can I choose standard Dutch or Belgian Dutch?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide describes both options. Specify your audience and preferred register in the prompt.

faq.question: Does the review check factual accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Its stated focus is linguistic style rather than factual truth. Review all rewritten claims before use.

faq.question: Does using the guide require visiting external websites?
faq.answer: The file includes author and catalog links but does not instruct the agent to visit them. Text processing depends on your host agent.
